summary: Online advertising platform for running search, display and video campaigns on Google.
access_note: Google Cloud project plus a developer token; Test access is automatic, Explorer/Basic are automated reviews, Standard needs manual review.
blocker_note: Production accounts need a developer token with Explorer/Basic/Standard access; Test access only works on test accounts.

evidence.quote: Just like other Google APIs, Google Ads API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication and authorization.
If you need Standard access, you need a manual review.
The Google Ads API can be called either using gRPC or REST.
The Google Ads MCP server provides a standardized bridge to the Google Ads API.

notes: Fetch summaries were used to extract quotes; Basic access described as automated on the developer token page.
